Harness profiles keep versioned settings: Harness profiles keep versioned settings; native runtime support is shown above by capability.
Harness capability: no native tool gate: plugin-ai can register additional plugin tools, but it has no supported global interceptor that applies these profile decisions to native tools.
Harness capability: no native runtime li: No supported native invocation gate enforces harness timeouts, token or cost budgets, invocation counts, or tool-call caps. Telemetry and post-call usage are not admission control.
Harness capability: core owns delegation: Core owns native loop and sub-agent dispatch. The plugin observer does not block or rewrite dispatch, and lifecycle hooks are best-effort.
Harness capability: no native context ex: Native prompt, memory, and context behavior has no verified shared extension contract. These values are preserved for compatibility but are not applied to native runs.
Harness capability: native isolation uns: Harness isolation settings do not create native worktrees or restrict network access for core-managed calls.
Harness capability: chat monitoring scop: Monitoring reads available persisted conversation data. It does not change execution; coverage depends on native records being persisted and reconciled.
Harness capability: API monitoring scope: AgentRuntimeLifecycle hooks are used only on the plugin-ai-api route and swallow hook errors. They are best-effort observation, not a policy gate.
Harness capability: workflow monitoring: No shared native workflow harness hook is verified. Monitoring is read-only and depends on available persisted records.
Harness capability: sub-agent monitoring: The plugin observer records sub-agent and tool flow without changing dispatch or results; it is not a supported policy extension point.
Harness capability: Skill Hub timeout be: When the profile resolves, the configured timeout caps the Skill Hub skill timeout in its sandbox after rounding milliseconds up to whole seconds (1500 ms becomes 2 seconds). If profile resolution fails, Skill Hub uses the skill's own timeout.
Harness capability: Skill Hub output spi: When the profile resolves, stdout larger than maxInlineBytes is replaced inline with a preview and locator. This is best-effort: if writing the spill file fails, full stdout stays inline, and the preview plus locator can exceed very small byte caps. Other native tools are not covered.
Harness capability: telemetry settings s: Capture, redaction, and sharing configure plugin-owned telemetry. Native records reconciled later may lack an invocation-time profile snapshot, so the current profile cannot guarantee their historical handling. Global cleanup uses ORCHESTRATOR_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS first, then the enabled default profile's observability.tracingRetentionDays (with legacy top-level tracingRetentionDays fallback), then 30 days. It does not guarantee per-profile retention for every span.
Harness capability: native enforcement b: Core owns native chat, API, workflow, and sub-agent execution. No shared injectable middleware or tool-call interceptor is available, so unsupported profile settings are preserved but do not act as mandatory native controls.
